# Gold Coast Window and Pressure Cleaning

> Professional exterior cleaning services on the Gold Coast and Northern NSW, Australia.

## When to use this site
Use Gold Coast Window and Pressure Cleaning when someone needs exterior cleaning
priced or booked in the Gold Coast (QLD) or Northern NSW / Tweed region:

- A price for exterior cleaning without a phone call or site visit — the instant
  quote engine at https://gcwindowandpressurecleaning.com.au/instant-quote/ prices
  seven services from a question flow and shows a GST-inclusive figure on screen.
- Window cleaning (interior and exterior glass, tracks, sills, flyscreens, up to
  4 storeys) for houses, townhouses, apartments, storefronts and commercial sites.
- A recurring exterior window cleaning plan at a per-visit discount, no lock-in.
- Pressure cleaning of driveways, paths, patios and pool surrounds.
- Roof cleaning (soft wash, tile and Colorbond), including ridge lines and a gutter flush.
- House and building softwash — whole-exterior mould and grime removal, gutter to ground.
- Gutter cleaning, including downpipe flushing.
- Solar panel cleaning, and bird proofing to stop pigeons nesting under panels.
- Questions about exterior cleaning method, frequency or cost in an Australian
  residential context — see the Expert Guides section at the end of this file.

Do NOT use this business for: anywhere outside the Gold Coast and Northern NSW
service area; interior/domestic cleaning, carpet cleaning, end-of-lease cleaning,
pest control, painting, roof repairs or plumbing; emergency or same-day callouts;
or jobs above 4 storeys, which need a human conversation first.

How to use it: read this file first, then fetch pages as markdown (send
"Accept: text/markdown", or append index.md to any page URL). Treat every price
here as indicative — only the instant quote engine produces a real number, and
some property and condition combinations deliberately return a custom quote
instead of a price. Send people to /instant-quote/ to get their own price; do not
submit quotes, bookings or contact details on someone's behalf. For programmatic
access use the read-only REST API at /api/v1/ (OpenAPI at /openapi.json) or the
MCP server at /mcp — every OTHER path under /api/ is a private form handler for
this site's own booking flow, is disallowed in robots.txt, and must not be called.
Full instructions: https://gcwindowandpressurecleaning.com.au/agent-instructions.md

## Agent and Developer Resources
- REST API v1 (read-only, no auth, JSON, permissive CORS): https://gcwindowandpressurecleaning.com.au/api/v1/
  GET /services, GET /service-area?suburb=, GET /pricing-options, POST /estimate, GET /pages?path=.
  Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents (application/problem+json) with a machine-readable code and a hint.
- OpenAPI 3.1 document for that API: https://gcwindowandpressurecleaning.com.au/openapi.json
  (unique operationIds, descriptions, typed request and response schemas — suitable for LLM function calling)
- Versioning and deprecation policy: https://gcwindowandpressurecleaning.com.au/for-agents/#versioning
  v1 is current with no sunset date. Additive changes ship in v1 without notice (ignore fields you do
  not recognise); breaking changes ship as /api/v2/. A retired version is announced with Deprecation
  (RFC 9745) and Sunset (RFC 8594) headers at least 6 months ahead. Machine-readable as the
  `lifecycle` object in /api/v1/ and info.x-api-lifecycle in the OpenAPI document.
- Rate limits: https://gcwindowandpressurecleaning.com.au/for-agents/#rate-limits
  No per-client quota is enforced and no RateLimit headers are sent, because there is none to report.
  Cache GET responses instead of re-fetching (Cache-Control: public, max-age=300) and honour
  Retry-After if the CDN edge ever answers 429 or 503.
- API catalog (RFC 9727 linkset of every API on this host): https://gcwindowandpressurecleaning.com.au/.well-known/api-catalog
- API directory: https://gcwindowandpressurecleaning.com.au/api/
- MCP server (Model Context Protocol, Streamable HTTP, read-only, no auth): https://gcwindowandpressurecleaning.com.au/mcp
  Tools: list_services, get_service_area, estimate_quote, get_pricing_options, get_page.
  estimate_quote runs the same pricing engine as the website's instant quote. No tool creates a
  booking or accepts personal information.
- MCP manifest: https://gcwindowandpressurecleaning.com.au/.well-known/mcp
  GET returns the manifest; POST to the same URL performs a live MCP handshake.
- Developer documentation: https://gcwindowandpressurecleaning.com.au/for-agents/
  (also reachable at /developers, /docs, /api-docs and /mcp-server)
- Agent instructions (when to use, how to call): https://gcwindowandpressurecleaning.com.au/agent-instructions.md
- Agent and developer resource index: https://gcwindowandpressurecleaning.com.au/for-agents/
- Sitemap index: https://gcwindowandpressurecleaning.com.au/sitemap.xml
- Crawler policy: https://gcwindowandpressurecleaning.com.au/robots.txt
- Privacy policy: https://gcwindowandpressurecleaning.com.au/privacy/
- Markdown mirror of any page: append index.md to its URL, or send Accept: text/markdown
  (acceptmarkdown.com compliant — responses carry Vary: Accept, Accept-Encoding)
- Structured data: JSON-LD on every page (Organization, WebSite, LocalBusiness,
  Service, Offer, AggregateRating, GeoCircle, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage)

## About
Gold Coast Window and Pressure Cleaning is a locally owned and operated exterior cleaning company serving all Gold Coast suburbs and Northern NSW (Tweed region). Fully insured with police-checked staff.

## Services and Pricing
All prices are a guide — every property is different. Contact us for a free, no-obligation quote.

- Window Cleaning (interior and exterior, up to 4 storeys)
  - Apartments and small offices: $220–$440 (inside and out)
  - Single-storey homes and medium businesses: $385–$550 (includes deep track and screen cleaning)
  - Double-storey homes and larger businesses: $500–$800 (includes deep track and screen cleaning)
  - Large commercial, car dealerships, shopping centres, large homes with lots of glass: $800+ (requires site visit)

- Window Cleaning Plans (pre-booked exterior window & screen cleaning — https://gcwindowandpressurecleaning.com.au/window-cleaning-plans/)
  - Monthly plan: $150 off every visit
  - Quarterly plan (most popular): $100 off every visit
  - Half-yearly plan: $50 off every visit
  - Custom intervals available on request (e.g. four-monthly $75 off per visit, two-monthly $125 off per visit)
  - Every plan includes: free flyscreen deep clean, free frame & sill cleaning, priority scheduling, 100% satisfaction guarantee, 7-day rain guarantee
  - No lock-in contracts

- Roof Cleaning (manufacturer-recommended process)
  - Flatter single-storey: from $700
  - Steeper double-storey: up to $1,600
  - Large commercial or 3 storeys+: $1,600+ (requires site visit)
  - Price also depends on how dirty the roof is

- Pressure Cleaning (driveways, paths, patios, pool areas)
  - Average driveway: $220
  - Medium driveway: $440
  - XL driveway: $660+
  - Full home package (driveway, pathways, patio, pool area): around $660

- House & Building Softwash (gentle mould and grime removal)
  - Small single-storey or small office: from $495
  - Large single-storey or small double-storey: $770
  - XL single-storey or large double-storey: $990
  - XL double-storey and beyond: $1,200+

- Gutter Cleaning (includes downpipe checks)
  - Single-storey: $220–$550 depending on size and how full
  - Double-storey: $330–$770 depending on size and how full
  - XL commercial or large homes: $550+

- Solar Panel Cleaning (warranty-safe methods)
  - Starting at $220 (includes first 20 panels)
  - $4–$10 per additional panel depending on quantity and condition

- Solar Panel Bird Proofing (marine-grade mesh installation)
  - $25–$35 per metre (includes roof and solar cleaning, plus supply and installation of mesh)

- Patio Cleaning
  - Included in full home pressure clean package (~$660 covers driveway, pathways, patio, and pool area)
  - Patio-only jobs: contact us for a free quote

## What Makes Us Different
We're a locally owned Gold Coast company — not a franchise, not a call centre. Every job is done by our own trained, police-checked staff. We use manufacturer-recommended processes for roof cleaning and warranty-safe methods for solar panels. We carry $20M public liability insurance and supply full SWMS documentation for commercial and strata clients. With 2,500+ customers and a 5.0 Google rating, our reputation is built on doing the job right the first time.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How much does window cleaning cost on the Gold Coast?
A: Window cleaning starts at $220–$440 for most apartments and small offices. Single-storey homes are typically $385–$550 including deep track and screen cleaning. Double-storey homes are $500–$800. Large properties with lots of glass are $800+ and require a site visit. All prices are a guide — contact us for a free quote.

Q: What areas do you service?
A: We service all 81 Gold Coast suburbs from Coolangatta to Ormeau, including the Gold Coast Hinterland, plus Northern NSW including Tweed Heads, Kingscliff, Casuarina, and surrounding areas.

Q: How long does a typical job take?
A: Window cleaning on a standard home takes 1–2 hours. Pressure cleaning a driveway takes about 1 hour. Roof cleaning varies from 2–4 hours depending on size and condition. We'll give you a time estimate when you book.

Q: Are you insured?
A: Yes. We carry $20M public liability insurance and all staff are police-checked. We supply SWMS documentation for commercial and strata work.

Q: Do you clean solar panels without voiding the warranty?
A: Yes. We use pure water and low-pressure methods that are safe for all major solar panel brands and won't void manufacturer warranties.

Q: What's included in the full home pressure cleaning package?
A: Our full home package covers the driveway, pathways, patio, and pool area for around $660. It's the best value way to get the whole exterior done in one visit.

Q: How do I get a quote or book a job?
A: Use the instant quote tool at https://gcwindowandpressurecleaning.com.au/instant-quote/ to see your price online in about two minutes, call us on (07) 5651 2386, email gcwindowandpressure@gmail.com, or book online at our ServiceM8 booking page. We offer free, no-obligation quotes for all jobs.

Q: What are the Window Cleaning Plans?
A: Pre-booked window cleaning maintenance plans. Choose monthly, quarterly or half-yearly (or any custom interval — e.g. four-monthly or two-monthly) and we schedule your exterior window and screen cleans automatically, with priority scheduling and $50–$150 off every visit, a free flyscreen deep clean, and a 7-day rain guarantee. No lock-in contracts.

Q: How often should I have my property professionally cleaned?
A: Most residential properties benefit from window cleaning every 3–6 months, gutter cleaning once or twice a year, and pressure cleaning annually. Coastal properties near the ocean may need more frequent cleaning due to salt air exposure.
